title: Face Sculpt Mixed-Age #211 · 한국 아이돌 20대 초 · 귀여운 · 바르도 립 극한 · 각진 턱 · 비닐 블랙립 · P50
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean pop idol visual fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and natural skin tone, early 20s, long straight black hair with soft see-through bangs, pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-black wet-look eyeshadow with a blinding chrome highlight across the lids, a thick graphic black liner, razor-sleek lashes, liquid mirror-gloss black vinyl lips reflecting the light, a razor-sharp cool contour, vivid hot-pink coloured contact lenses with a thick dark outer ring and round natural pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, wide bright eyes, cheeks lifted by a playful half-smile with a hint of teeth, a cute, playful expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the absolute extreme of a 'Bardot pout': an upper lip that is huge, puffy and pillow-like, twice as thick as the lower lip, swelling far forward and upward and overhanging the slimmer, flatter lower lip tucked beneath it, its two soft rounded peaks plump as small cushions, the whole pout projecting far forward from her face, mirror-glossy deep rose with bright white highlights on the upper lip, every edge razor-crisp, perfectly symmetrical, so that the lips are by far the dominant feature of her face in this three-quarter view, still reading as a beautiful, believable human face, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty-five in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; three small bar or rings through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; five small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; three small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive weights, each of a different shape, all of them blackened rough cast iron with a hammered, uneven surface, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal: on the left ear a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, a miniature anvil on a shortest chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a short chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a medium chain, a round bell on a long chain, a square-sided cowbell on a long chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a longer chain, a ship's anchor on a longest chain; on the right ear a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a shortest chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a short chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a medium chain, a cube-shaped block on a long chain, a square-sided cowbell on a long chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a longer chain, a round bell on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
